**BOHJ19H4 - Behandling med vedolizumab** is a clinical procedure code utilized within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease registry (DANIBD) to track and register treatments involving vedolizumab, an α4β7 integrin inhibitor. As part of the national framework for monitoring inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), this code plays a critical role in evaluating patient access to advanced therapies and benchmarking clinical outcomes across Danish regions.

Within the registry's quality indicators—specifically those focusing on the use of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (biologics and targeted synthetic drugs)—vedolizumab emerges as a highly prevalent treatment. During the 2022–2023 reporting period, BOHJ19H4 was among the most frequently administered BMSL treatments for adults and ranked as the second most common among children [^src1]. Specifically, the code was registered for 42 children and young people (representing 12% of that demographic) and 1,735 adults (17%) during this timeframe [^src1]. 

Subsequent data from the 2024 DANIBD report continues to track this treatment code across various patient subsets and quality indicators, reflecting its ongoing importance in the standardized coding and evidence-based development of IBD treatment guidelines in Denmark [^src2]. The systematic tracking of BOHJ19H4 allows the DANIBD steering group and clinical teams to monitor treatment frequencies, patient characteristics, and the overall distribution of biologic therapies in Danish IBD care [^src2].
